messages:
Maria: @all seeing a spike of 429s for a few enterprise customers since the midnight rollout. Dashboard shows per-org rate limits dropped to 100 r/s — expected 1000.
Jake: Can you paste an example curl + response?
Maria: ```curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{...}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```
Maria: Response snippet: 
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-org-quota: 100
Kai: confirmed in logs: enforcement-service returned quota=100 for org_id=org_zeppelin after config reload. I think mapping rule was dropped during merge.
Anya: Did we change quota-service schema in yesterday's PR? @Kai
Kai: Yes — PR #842 changed default override merging and I forgot the migration that repopulates org_overrides.
quota-bot: [automation] :rotating_light: alert: per_org_quota_regression detected for 3 orgs (org_zeppelin, org_alpine, org_petal)
Jake: :rotating_light: rolling back enforcement-config to previous release now — running `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/enforcement`
Jake: Command output: `deployment.apps/enforcement "enforcement" rolled back`
Maria: Also opened emergency override in Console -> Quotas -> Emergency Mode for affected orgs (temporarily disables enforcement for release window).
Kai: I'll prepare a hotfix: revert the merge behaviour and add a migration that fills missing overrides. Pushing branch `fix/quota-migration` now.
Anya: Telemetry query I ran: `SELECT org_id, count(*) FROM requests WHERE status=429 AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY org_id ORDER BY count DESC;`
Anya: Results: org_zeppelin 482, org_alpine 211, org_petal 74
Jake: After rollback, 429s dropped to ~5/min for org_zeppelin. Monitoring the dashboard.
Maria: Immediate action items:
- rollback (done)
- emergency overrides (done)
- hotfix PR from Kai -> QA canary
- notify affected customers (support loop)
Maria: Longer-term: add migration test to CI, create an integration test for quota-schema changes, dashboard alert for per-org quota deviation >20%
Kai: Hotfix PR up: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/enforcement/pulls/847 (includes migration + unit tests). ETA to merge after canary: 40m.
Jake: Canary saw no regressions after 15m. Proceeding to promote and then restart enforcement replicas in eu-west-1 and us-west-2.
Anya: I'll draft a short incident summary for the oncall page and ping product for customer comms.
Maria: Thanks. Adding a retrospective to the backlog and assigning quarantine ticket to infra team.
Anya: Closing incident here for now — will add postmortem when we have root cause and timeline. :thumbsup:
Maria: Marking incident as resolved in PagerDuty. Keeping the channel open for postmortem notes.
